package.name: uav_mission
package.description:
The aircraft doing a task on its own. search_node flies the Task 1 buoy search: it sweeps the fence the autopilot holds, hovers over each buoy the map still calls UNKNOWN until buoy_mapper locks its state, and asks for RTL once the ground station's count of buoys is confirmed.
It OWNS NOTHING. No MAVLink connection (telemetry_bridge forwards its targets, after checking them), no camera, no map (buoy_mapper's). It only moves the aircraft while the pilot has GUIDED selected, and it only starts on the pilot's switch into GUIDED -- never from a web page.
Pure Python and plain ROS messages, so it runs on any image, unlike uav_perception.
